product_metadata.title: Pampas Grass Bouquet, 80 PCS Long Lasting Dried Flowers for Boho Room Decor, Vase Filler, Fluffy Dried Pampas for Floral Arrangements, Summer Pompas & Wedding Shower
features: Dried Pampas Grass Decor: Short pampas grass and dried grass decor is the perfect spring decor for your home or boho party. Pompas is low maintenance & sure to impress, with an effortless and elegant boho look in any setting. Pampas grass can be used for dining table decor, wedding decor, baby shower decorations, bridal shower decorations, or in the bathroom, laundry room, bedroom & more. Carefully picked, high quality non-toxic natural pompas grass. NO faux pampas grass chemical smell.

Included: 80 Pieces of Multiple kinds of pampass grass in one pompas floral package. Includes 20 neutral brown pampas, 20 white pampas and 40 natural reed pampas. Bouquet can be one large display, or separated into multiple smaller bouquets, creating many different bohemian or mid-century modern looks. Includes box to protect the pampass grass as it travels to you, and makes for a beautiful gift. Box creates an easy way to store pampas for future use.

Fits Most Vases: Each piece is approximately 18 inches, or 45 CM long which makes this small pampas grass vase filler perfectly versatile and great for a short pampas grass vase, for centrepiece table decorations, coffee tables or entrance stand displays. Get creative and pair pampas with other dried floral or Eucalyptus for a beautiful versatile look.

Low Maintenance Care: Dried pampas grass needs No watering. Once set in place, it is extremely low maintenance. Simply give pampas a light shake outside to fluff and remove natural shedding. Place in the sun for a few hours for extra fluffiness. Lightly spray with hairspray and enjoy. PLEASE NOTE - this is REAL Pampas grass, so some shedding and slight variation in size is normal. Each stem is delicate so handle with care.

Curated By Designers: NATURL Pampas is designed in the US, for those with an eye for beautiful design and decor in mind.
